summary: The generated main.go prints the command error and owns the exit code, so the root command must silence cobra's own error printer or every failure is emitted twice.
reason: Both printers were active. That read as cosmetic while errors were a single line, but diagnostics that explain an unrecoverable upstream change run to a paragraph, and duplicating one buries the remedy it exists to deliver. main.go is generated and marked DO NOT EDIT, so the root command is the side that has to hold.
validated_outcome: A failing command prints its error once instead of twice, on stderr only, with the exit code unchanged.
